text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Alright. That was an exceptionally good 
session leading up to the Japan Cup...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth really is seriously 
skilled...! I wonder which race she'll 
enter this autumn?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if they'll show up at the Japan 
Cup or Arima Kinen... I really think I can 
put up a good fight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after the race, Sounds of Earth was 
interviewed by reporters in the waiting 
room—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Then your next major goal is the Japan 
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Let us make it roar out to the whole 
world! The wondrous melodies born of this 
era!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to it. It will definitely be 
an unforgettable Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And in that magnificent race, the one that 
will resonate most resoundingly is—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Sounds of Earth's next goal is the 
Japan Cup, huh! Nice, nice! Things are 
really heating up!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She's talking pretty big, isn't she? Must 
mean she's confident. Either way, I can't 
wait...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
choice_data_list: We're gonna push it even harder!
We're going to push it even harder!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Okay...! Just what I was hoping for...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To greater heights...! Let us perform 
beyond our limits!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer is drawing to a close, as the 
footsteps leading to the Japan Cup echo 
near—
